4490-6582--210.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4490-6582--210.description:
Give Shalai and Hallar lifelink, if needed.
Gain life.
Aerith Gainsborough triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing damage to an opponent and causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 3.
4490-6582--210.notes: Additional mana and/or prerequisites may be required depending on the method used to give Shalai and Hallar lifelink.

5641-6258-6566.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Yuna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

225-4365-4772-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2498-7844.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2498-7844.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's Bargain by paying 1 life, causing you to draw a card.
Sheoldred's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

1987-2493-6573.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-2493-6573.notablePrerequisites: You've cast a commander from the command zone two or more times this game.
1987-2493-6573.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2493-6573.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

215-3499-5614.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
215-3499-5614.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Bighorner Rancher from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Bighorner Rancher by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1373-3946-7705.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2180-4050-6972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nearheath Stalker
When Nearheath Stalker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nearheath Stalker
When Nearheath Stalker dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Nearheath Stalker enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.
2180-4050-6972.notes: If Nearheath Stalker starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

206-4053-5499--5.notablePrerequisites: The creature with persist does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
206-4053-5499--5.description:
Activate the creature with persist by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the persist creature.
Repeat.

283-4682-7132.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger more than two times.
283-4682-7132.description:
Activate Super-Skrull's fourth ability by paying {5}{U}, targeting an opponent.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Super-Skrull's ability, targeting the same opponent.
Resolve the first Super-Skrull ability, causing the opponent to draw four cards.
Smothering Tithe triggers four times, causing you to create a Treasure token for each time the opponent cannot pay for the trigger.
Repeat steps 3 and 4 for the other Super-Skrull ability.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{U}.
Repeat.
283-4682-7132.notes:
If the opponent can pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger more times, you can still perform the combo if you have enough mana to outlast their mana supply. You can also continue this combo for other opponents if mana allows.
The extra mana can be used to activate any of Super-Skrull's abilities.

4067-6281-6893-7252.notablePrerequisites: The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it.
4067-6281-6893-7252.description:
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding at least twenty {U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Grave Sifter.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Grave Sifter that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Grave Sifter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Grave Sifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat.

1020-2034-2866-6289.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Voyager Quickwelder.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Voyager Quickwelder.
Repeat.

539-3967-7008.description:
Cast Badgermole Cub by paying its mana cost
When Badgermole Cub enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Badgermole Cub
When Badgermole Cub dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Badgermole Cub enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2061-3617-6991.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Donnie & April.
Put the Donnie & April token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Donnie & April token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

789-2399-2511--129.easyPrerequisites: Gutter Grime has slime counters on it at least equal to the toughness of the creature card in your hand.
789-2399-2511--129.description:
Cast the creature card in your hand by paying {0}.
Either that creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, or activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing that creature.
Gutter Grime triggers, putting a slime counter on it and creating a X/X Ooze creature token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Ooze.
When the Ooze dies, Colfenor triggers, returning the creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities, putting a +1/+1 counter on it each time.
789-2399-2511--129.notes: This combo also puts infinite slime counters on Gutter Grime, allowing you to easily create additional infinitely large creature tokens.

2034-4823-4871-6476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
2034-4823-4871-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Timeless Witness and at least two other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing three of the creatures returned in step 1, adding six {C}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate the three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

511-817-3334-4050-6441.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

1479-4677-5621.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-4677-5621.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Zendikar's Roil, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

3259-4359-5768.notablePrerequisites:
Origin of the Hidden Ones has exactly two lore counters on it.
You control at least one Assassin that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4359-5768.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
Origin of the Hidden Ones' third chapter ability triggers, causing you to create an Assassin token whenever an Assassin attacks this turn and sacrifice Origin of the Hidden Ones.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached, and at least one Assassin if the creature with Breath of Fury attached isn't an Assassin, as attackers.
Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

2388-3259-4068.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
2388-3259-4068.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Golden-Gear Colossus as attackers.
The Golden-Gear Colossus triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1570-2267-3674.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a non-Human creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
1570-2267-3674.description:
Cause a non-Human creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Sage of the Falls triggers, causing you to mill two cards, return Necroplasm from your graveyard to your hand, and discard Necroplasm.
Tormod triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-1283-4772.easyPrerequisites: Jetfire has no +1/+1 counters on it.
114-1283-4772.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting six +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

152-1283-1434-4772.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Chromatic Orrery.
Activate the Chromatic Orrery copies first abilities by tapping them, adding {10}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead activate the Chromatic Orrery tokens' second abilities to draw infinite cards.

372-4783-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Abdel Adrian.
Choose to have Abdel Adrian returned to the command zone from your graveyard.
Hellkite Courser returns to the battlefield from exile, triggering itself, putting Abdel Adrain from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Hellkite Courser and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

891-1703-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Fool's Demise's first and second ability triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Fool's Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise ability, doing nothing,.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.

148-4971.notablePrerequisites:
Keen Sense attached to Niv-Mizzet.
You have a way to draw a card.
148-4971.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Keen Sense triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
